metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: MODIS-Aqua Level-2 Ocean Color (OC) 1-km 8-day composites (`NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L2/OC`) is the best native product for chlorophyll-a (chl-a) blooms; if no 2015 image exists, fall back to MODIS Daily Surface Reflectance 8-Day Global 500 m (`MODIS/006/MYD09A1`) and derive a greenness proxy (e.g. (NIR-G)/(NIR+G)). - Date: 2015-10-10 ±4 d (i.e. 2015-10-06 → 2015-10-14) to ensure at least one scene. - Location: 5-km offshore box west of Santa Monica pier (34.01 N, 118.50 W) – small polygon just outside the surf zone. 2. Masking strategy - For OC chlorophyll band: mask quality-control “l2_flags” so that only best pixels (no land, clouds, straylight, high sun-glint) remain. - For MYD09A1: use the supplied state QA to mask clouds/cloud-shadow and land. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null - After masking, count valid pixels; if 0 → print C2. - Retrieve mean chlorophyll (or greenness proxy); if None/NaN → print C3. - Santa Monica coastal water baseline chl-a ≈ 0.5 mg m⁻³; bloom threshold ≈ 2 mg m⁻³ (or NDGI ≈ 0.2). If mean > threshold → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. ROI: 5-km box just off Santa Monica coast roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.55, 34.00, -118.45, 34.02]) # ~5 km offshore # 2. Masking & bloom proxy def mask_oc(img): qa = img.select('l2_flags') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(2).eq(0)) # no land/cloud return img.updateMask(mask).select(['chlor_a']).float() if 'chlor_a' in col.first().bandNames().getInfo(): col = col.map(mask_oc) band = 'chlor_a' else: # derive NDGI greenness proxy from MYD09A1 def ndgi(img): qa = img.select('StateQA') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<0).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<1)) land = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3) mask = cloud.Or(land).Not() ndgi = img.normalizedDifference(['sur_refl_b02','sur_refl_b04']).rename('NDGI') return img.addBands(ndgi).select(['NDGI']).updateMask(mask) col = col.map(ndgi) band = 'NDGI' # 4. Mosaic & stats img = col.median() count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid coastal pixels after masking.") print("C2") elif mean is None or (band=='chlor_a' and (mean>100 or mean<0)) or (band=='NDGI' and abs(mean)>1): print("Calculation yielded invalid value.") print("C3") else: print(f"2015-10-10 mean: {mean:.2f}, pixels: {int(count)}") bloom = mean > 2.0 if band=='chlor_a' else mean > 0.2 print("A" if bloom else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. ROI: 5-km box just off Santa Monica coast
roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.55, 34.00, -118.45, 34.02])  # ~5 km offshore

# 2. Try MODIS-Aqua L2 OC 8-day first
start, end = '2015-10-06', '2015-10-14'
col = ee.ImageCollection("NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L2/OC") \
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    # fallback to MODIS 8-Day SR
    col = ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MYD09A1") \
            .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi)
    n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No images found 2015-10-06–14.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Masking & bloom proxy
def mask_oc(img):
    qa = img.select('l2_flags')
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(2).eq(0))  # no land/cloud
    return img.updateMask(mask).select(['chlor_a']).float()
if 'chlor_a' in col.first().bandNames().getInfo():
    col = col.map(mask_oc)
    band = 'chlor_a'
else:
    # derive NDGI greenness proxy from MYD09A1
    def ndgi(img):
        qa = img.select('StateQA')
        cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<0).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<1))
        land = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3)
        mask = cloud.Or(land).Not()
        ndgi = img.normalizedDifference(['sur_refl_b02','sur_refl_b04']).rename('NDGI')
        return img.addBands(ndgi).select(['NDGI']).updateMask(mask)
    col = col.map(ndgi)
    band = 'NDGI'

# 4. Mosaic & stats
img = col.median()
count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
mean  = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),  geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()

if count == 0:
    print("No valid coastal pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif mean is None or (band=='chlor_a' and (mean>100 or mean<0)) or (band=='NDGI' and abs(mean)>1):
    print("Calculation yielded invalid value.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2015-10-10 mean: {mean:.2f}, pixels: {int(count)}")
    bloom = mean > 2.0 if band=='chlor_a' else mean > 0.2
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if bloom else "<answer>B</answer>")
